result:
Confirmado: `settingSourceToScope` devuelve `Exclude<PluginScope, 'managed'>` (sin `'flag'`), así que `.toBe('flag')` no tipa aunque el runtime sí produzca `'flag'` para `'flagSettings'`. Amplío el tipo del valor actual con `ExtendedPluginScope` (que sí incluye `'flag'`), sin tocar el argumento ni el comportamiento.

```json

    "new": "import {\n  buildPluginId,\n  type ExtendedPluginScope,\n  isOfficialMarketplaceName,\n  parsePluginIdentifier,\n  scopeToSettingSource,\n  settingSourceToScope,\n} from '../plugin/pluginIdentifier.js'"},
   {"old": "    expect(settingSourceToScope('flagSettings' as never)).toBe('flag')",
    "new": "    expect(settingSourceToScope('flagSettings' as never) as ExtendedPluginScope).toBe(\n      'flag',\n    )"}
```
